title: Modulation of aryl hydrocarbon receptor activity by halogenated indoles.
authors: Vrzalova, Aneta; Vrzal, Radim; Nadvornik, Petr; Sebela, Marek; Dvorak, Zdenek
one_liner_zh: 该文研究卤代吲哚配体对AhR转录因子的激活作用，结合分子对接与功能实验分析配体-PAS-B域结合，虽涉及TF-DNA互作但以配体调控为主，方法上仅用分子对接，深度有限。
abstract: The aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) is a cytosolic ligand-activated transcription factor integral to various physiological and pathological processes. Among its diverse ligands, indole-based compounds have garnered attention due to their significant biological activity and potential therapeutic applications. This study explores the activation of AhR by structurally diverse halogenated indoles. We evaluated the transcriptional activity of AhR and cell viability in the human LS174T-AhR-luc reporter cell line. Among the tested compounds, 4-FI, 7-FI, 6-BrI, 7-BrI, 6-Cl-2-ox, 5-Br-2-ox, and 6-Br-2-ox activated AhR in a concentration-dependent manner, displaying high efficacy and potency. Molecular docking analysis revealed moderate binding affinities of these compounds to the PAS-B domain of AhR, corroborated by competitive radioligand binding assays. Functional assays showed that halogenated indoles induce the formation of AhR-ARNT heterodimer and enhance the binding of the AhR to the CYP1A1 promoter. Additionally, 4-FI and 7-FI exhibited anti-inflammatory properties in Caco-2 cell models, highlighting their potential for therapeutic applications. This study underscores the significance of the type and position of halogen moiety in indole scaffold, suggesting their potential as candidates for developing therapeutics drugs to treat conditions such as inflammatory bowel disease via AhR activation.
abstract_zh: 芳香烃受体（aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AhR）是一种胞质内配体激活的转录因子，参与多种生理和病理过程。在其众多配体中，吲哚类化合物因其显著的生物活性和潜在治疗应用而受到关注。本研究探讨了结构多样的卤代吲哚对AhR的激活作用。我们在人LS174T-AhR-luc报告细胞系中评估了AhR的转录活性和细胞活力。在所测试的化合物中，4-FI、7-FI、6-BrI、7-BrI、6-Cl-2-ox、5-Br-2-ox和6-Br-2-ox以浓度依赖性方式激活AhR，表现出高效力和高活性。分子对接分析显示，这些化合物与AhR的PAS-B结构域具有中等结合亲和力，并通过竞争性放射性配体结合实验得到证实。功能实验表明，卤代吲哚诱导AhR-ARNT异二聚体的形成，并增强AhR与CYP1A1启动子的结合。此外，4-FI和7-FI在Caco-2细胞模型中表现出抗炎特性，凸显了其治疗应用的潜力。本研究强调了吲哚骨架中卤素部分的类型和位置的重要性，提示它们可能作为通过AhR激活治疗炎症性肠病等疾病的候选药物开发方向。
